paragraphs: As an experienced software engineer, I specialize in developing scalable and robust web apps using javascript stack. I have a solid foundation in front-end development using React, Vue, Next JS, typescript, Redux, and other libraries and experience in back-end development with Node.js, Nest JS and firebase. Additionally, I am proficient in database management using MongoDB, and have experience with different database technologies such as MySQL and PostgreSQL.

Throughout my career, I have worked on projects for clients in various industries, including e-commerce, healthcare, and food tech. I am adept at collaborating with cross-functional teams and have experience working in Agile environments. Passionate about exploring new tech trends and frameworks.

If you are looking for a skilled and reliable full-stack MERN developer who can help you build high-quality web applications, please don't hesitate to contact me. Let's connect and create something extraordinary together!
